title: Programming & Electronic Engineer Mentor
description:
**About the Role**

TIS runs makerspace and innovation programmes inside schools. As a Programming \+ Electronics Mentor, you will teach and guide students from Grades 1\-8 through hands\-on learning in coding, electronics, and physical computing. You will run makerspace activities. You will help students move from curiosity to building, tinkering, and problem\-solving with real projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Teaching and mentoring**

● Deliver class\-appropriate programming and electronics sessions across Grades 1\-8 as per curriculum, from unplugged coding and block\-based tools in the early grades to text\-based coding and microcontroller projects in the upper grades.

● Guide students through circuits, sensors, motors, LEDs, and microcontroller platforms such as Arduino, micro:bit, and ESP32\.

● Facilitate project\-based, inquiry\-driven learning that fits an IB (PYP/MYP) approach.

● Encourage design thinking, debugging, iteration, and reflection in every project.

**Curriculum and content**

● Help implement makerspace curriculum, including lesson plans, project guides, and assessment rubrics.

● Prepare learning materials, demo builds, and student worksheets.

● Contribute ideas for showcase events, exhibitions, and student\-led conferences.

**Makerspace operations**

● Maintain tools, components, and kits, and keep inventory records.

● Enforce safety practices for soldering, power tools, batteries, and electronics.

● Keep the lab organised, labelled, and ready for sessions.

**Collaboration and reporting**

● Work closely with school teachers, coordinators, and the TIS team to align sessions with the school calendar.

● Track student progress and share updates and feedback with the Program Manager.

● Document projects with photos, videos, and short write\-ups.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on experience).

● Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C/C\+\+, or Scratch, and block\-based platforms.

● Hands\-on experience with Arduino or similar microcontrollers, basic circuit design, and sensors/actuators.

● Ability to explain technical concepts simply to children of different ages.

● Strong classroom management, patience, and communication skills.

● Comfort with troubleshooting hardware and software issues in real time.

**Good to Have**

● Experience teaching or mentoring school students, or running workshops or clubs.

● Familiarity with robotics platforms or competitions.

● Exposure to IB, project\-based, or inquiry\-led learning.

● Basic knowledge of 3D printing, CAD, or laser cutting.

● Interest in AI/ML concepts for young learners.

**What We're Looking For**

● A curious, hands\-on maker who enjoys learning alongside students

● A patient, energetic communicator who can hold attention across age groups

● A team player who is organised, dependable, and safety\-conscious

● Someone who welcomes feedback and keeps improving their teaching

**What You'll Gain**

● Work in a well\-equipped school makerspace, with room to shape programmes as they grow

● Exposure to national robotics competitions and school\-industry partnerships

● Mentorship, training, and growth within a young, mission\-driven education team

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: QA Team Lead (Web Scraping & Data Extraction)
description:
**About Actowiz Solutions**
===========================


Actowiz Solutions is a leading provider of web scraping, data extraction, and market intelligence solutions. We help global enterprises collect, process, and deliver structured data from eCommerce, Quick Commerce, Retail, Travel, Food Delivery, Automotive, Real Estate, and other digital platforms.
We are looking for an experienced **QA Team Lead** who can lead a team of QA Engineers, ensure high\-quality client deliveries, improve QA processes, and collaborate closely with developers and project managers to maintain exceptional data quality across multiple web scraping projects.**Role Overview**
=================


As a QA Team Lead, you will be responsible for leading day\-to\-day QA activities across multiple web scraping and data extraction projects. You will mentor QA Engineers, establish testing standards, review deliverables, identify process improvements, and ensure that every client delivery meets the required quality benchmarks.
The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, excellent analytical abilities, and hands\-on experience validating large\-scale scraped datasets.**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Leadership**
-------------------

* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of QA Engineers.
* Assign QA tasks and monitor daily progress.
* Conduct regular knowledge\-sharing sessions and team training.
* Review team performance and provide constructive feedback.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and mentoring of new QA team members.

**Data Quality Assurance**
--------------------------

* Validate datasets for:
	+ Accuracy
	+ Completeness
	+ Freshness
	+ Consistency
	+ Formatting
	+ Duplicate records
* Review client deliverables before submission.
* Ensure adherence to project\-specific validation checklists and SOPs.
* Verify data against client requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Testing \& Validation**
-------------------------

* Prepare detailed test plans and test cases for scraping projects.
* Perform functional and regression testing of web scrapers and APIs.
* Validate parser outputs after website structure changes.
* Identify missing fields, incorrect mappings, duplicate records, and formatting inconsistencies.
* Perform sanity checks before production deliveries.

**Scraper Validation**
----------------------

* Test web scraping applications, crawlers, APIs, and ETL pipelines.
* Monitor scraping performance and data quality after deployments.
* Validate outputs across multiple websites and data sources.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve extraction and parsing issues.

**Process Improvement**
-----------------------

* Improve QA processes, validation methodologies, and checklists.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain documentation for QA processes and project\-specific validations.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality and efficiency.

**Reporting \& Coordination**
-----------------------------

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Developers, Business Analysts, and Delivery teams.
* Track QA progress across multiple projects.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly QA reports.
* Escalate critical quality issues and project risks proactively.
* Ensure project deliveries meet defined SLAs and timelines.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in Software Testing or Quality Assurance.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading a QA team.
* Experience working on web scraping, data extraction, or data validation projects.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and leadership skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Must Have**
-------------

* Strong understanding of:
	+ HTML
	+ DOM
	+ XPath
	+ CSS Selectors
	+ JSON
	+ XML
* Hands\-on experience with:
	+ SQL
	+ REST APIs
	+ Data validation techniques
* Experience testing:
	+ Web Scrapers
	+ Crawlers
	+ APIs
	+ ETL Pipelines
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Strong understanding of Excel and large dataset validation.

**Preferred Skills**
====================

* Basic knowledge of Python scripting for QA automation.
* Experience with distributed web scraping frameworks.
* Understanding of proxy management and anti\-bot mechanisms.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.
* Exposure to automated data validation frameworks.
* Experience in a Web Scraping, Market Intelligence, or Data\-as\-a\-Service (DaaS) company.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================


The QA Team Lead should be capable of:* Managing a team of QA Engineers effectively.
* Handling multiple client projects simultaneously.
* Ensuring on\-time project deliveries with high quality.
* Mentoring junior QA team members.
* Coordinating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Driving continuous process improvements within the QA function.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
=====================================

* Data Accuracy (%)
* First\-Time Right (FTR)
* Defect Leakage Rate
* Production Defects
* On\-Time Delivery
* SLA Compliance
* Team Productivity
* Quality Audit Score
* Client Acceptance Rate
* Root Cause Closure Rate
* QA Documentation Compliance
* Client Satisfaction (CSAT)

**Why Join Actowiz Solutions?**
===============================

* Work on global web scraping and market intelligence projects.
* Lead a talented and growing QA team.
* Gain exposure to cutting\-edge data extraction technologies.
* Enjoy continuous learning and career advancement opportunities.
* Be part of a collaborative, innovation\-driven work environment.

 **If you have a passion for quality, leadership, and large\-scale data validation, we would love to have you join the Actowiz Solutions team.**

title: AI Visual & Video Creator
description:
**Designation : AI Visual and Video Creator**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative and technically skilled AI Visual and Video Creator to produce high\-quality images, social media creatives, AI reels and promotional videos for multiple brands.

The ideal candidate should understand visual storytelling, social media trends, branding and AI\-powered content creation. This role requires someone who can transform briefs, scripts and product information into engaging visual content.

AI Visual and Video Creator

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Create AI\-generated images, product visuals and branded social media creatives.
* Produce short\-form videos and reels for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other digital platforms.
* Create AI avatar, voice\-over, explainer, promotional and product demonstration videos.
* Convert scripts and marketing concepts into visually engaging content.
* Edit raw footage and AI\-generated assets into polished videos.
* Add subtitles, transitions, animations, music, sound effects and brand elements.
* Design platform\-specific content in the required dimensions and formats.
* Maintain consistent brand identity across all visuals and videos.
* Create multiple variations of creatives for advertising campaigns and A/B testing.
* Collaborate with content writers, social media executives and performance marketing specialists.
* Research visual trends, viral formats and new AI creative tools.
* Organise project files and deliver content according to the publishing calendar.
* Revise creatives based on internal or client feedback.
* Ensure that AI\-generated content is accurate, appropriate and commercially usable.

**Required Skills :**

* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography and colour.
* Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or similar design tools using AI
* Video\-editing experience using CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar software using AI.
* Hands\-on experience with AI image and video\-generation tools.
* Ability to write effective prompts for generating consistent visuals.
* Understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and paid\-ad creatives.
* Ability to maintain character, product and brand consistency in AI\-generated content.
* Good communication, time\-management and attention\-to\-detail skills.
* Ability to manage creative requirements for multiple brands simultaneously.

**Portfolio Requirement:** Candidates must submit 5 AI\-created videos and 5 social media posts developed using AI tools or their graphic\-design skills. Please clearly mention the tools used and their role in creating each sample.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Video Editor
description:
Kody Technolab Ltd. is a publicly listed deep\-tech company specializing in AI\-powered

robotics, autonomous systems, and enterprise software. With 250\+ projects delivered

across 30\+ countries, and a portfolio of proprietary robots (Odigo, Dasher, Spilot, Vulcan,

etc.), we are redefining how businesses adopt automation.

We are now looking for a creative, tech\-savvy Video Editor who can bring our robotics

vision to life through high\-impact videos, product stories, brand campaigns, and investor

grade communication assets.

**Role Overview**

You will be responsible for creating world\-class video content that showcases our robots,

software platforms, customer deployments, brand campaigns, and corporate

communication. This includes product videos, launch films, explainer videos, reels,

motion graphics, and video assets for presentations, events, and PR.

You must understand aesthetics, storytelling, pacing, and be able to interpret technical

content to craft engaging visual narratives.

**What You’ll Do**

* Edit raw footage into polished videos for marketing, product demos, events, and

social media

* Create short\-form videos (reels, shorts, teasers, reveal videos) for brand

amplification

* Produce long\-form content such as walkthroughs, interviews, explainer videos, and

case studies• Craft cinematic, engaging product videos that highlight robotics features \&

interactions

* Create animated visuals, UI overlays, transitions, product callouts, and brand

identity elements

* Design intro/outro sequences aligned with Kody’s brand identity
* Add AI\-focused, futuristic elements \& visual cues where required
* Work closely with marketing, robotics, product \& design teams
* Provide creative direction during shoots; ability to plan and storyboard is a strong

plus

* Collaborate with internal designers and external agencies when needed
* Understand brand tonality, engineering accuracy, and storytelling intent
* Color grading, sound design, music selection \& audio cleanup
* Manage and organize footage, proxies, archives, and project files
* Ensure all exports meet platform specs (LinkedIn, YouTube, social media,

presentations, events)

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 3\-4 years of experience in video editing, motion graphics, or visual storytelling
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro etc.
* Experience using AI video editing and image creation tools
* Ability to edit fast paced and slow cinematic styles
* Great sense of pacing, transitions, music sync, and visual flow
* You’re curious about AI, robotics, automation, and futuristic tech storytelling
* Excellent attention to detail, color sense, typography, and aesthetics
* Ability to work under timelines while maintaining quality
* Experience in filming (camera operation, lighting) is a strong advantage
* Portfolio demonstrating product videos, brand films, and motion graphics

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Solutions Expert - Technology
description:
### **Responsibilities**



Technology Leadership (OT \& Digital)


* Own OT and digital architecture across PLC, SCADA, DCS, IoT, Edge, Historians, AR/ VR, Computer Vision, MES, Digital Twin, Industrial AI, data and analytics platforms.
* Define and enforce technology standards, reference architectures, and lifecycle management practices.
* Act as the technology solutions expert for digital and automation initiatives.


Digital Transformation \& Use Case Enablement


* Translate business and operational requirements into robust digital solutions.
* Enable Industry 4\.0 use cases (MES, Digital Twin, AR/ VR, Computer Vision, Industrial AI) such as predictive maintenance, process optimization, quality and energy optimization.
* Support pilots, POCs and roll\-out in coordination with project and site teams.


OT Systems \& Cybersecurity


* Ensure availability, reliability and performance of OT systems.
* Define and implement OT cybersecurity controls aligned with ISA/IEC 62443\.
* Work very closely with the Cyber security Team and assist in patching and upgrades, backups and disaster recovery exercises for OT environments.


Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)


* HSE leadership and visible commitment
* Safety‑by‑design for OT \& digital systems
* Statutory and site compliance (PTW, commissioning, maintenance) – for project implementation, the candidate must provide clear guidance pertaining to safety requirements, to the Business Partner and their Team members.
* Contribute to Incident investigation and corrective actions as and when required.
* Use of digital technologies for safety and environmental monitoring


Project \& Delivery Collaboration


* Partner with Integral Project Managers to provide design, estimation and risk inputs.
* Review vendor proposals, solution design and ensure adherence to technology and security standards.
* Prepare technical updates and presentations, as necessary and directed by the Executive Leadership Team.


Stakeholder \& Vendor Management


* Act as primary technical interface between various stakeholders (mine/plant operations teams, Digital team, Group IT and technology partners).
* Evaluate and recommend technology platforms, OEMs and system integrators.
* Champion Change Management, so that applications that are rolled out are implemented in a flawless manner.

### **Qualifications**


* 15–20 years of experience in digital technology, process control and optimization roles.


* Strong experience in Metals, Mining, Process Manufacturing industries.


* Good knowledge in PLC, SCADA, DCS, OT–IT integration, IoT and industrial data platforms.


* Working knowledge of cloud platforms, data analytics and visualization.


* Experience supporting large\-scale digital or automation projects



Education \& Certifications • Bachelor’s/ master’s degree in engineering


* Certifications in OT, cybersecurity (ISA/IEC 62443\), digital or cloud platforms are desirable
